The operational process at Fashion Forward exhibits a significant bottleneck due to the use of an outdated first-in-first-out (FIFO) storage system. This method creates inefficiencies by placing newer stock behind older items, leading to time-consuming reorganization efforts whenever recent inventory is required for shipment. To improve efficiency, the company should consider implementing a more dynamic storage system, such as a random location system or a slotting optimization strategy, which allows for easier access to all items regardless of their arrival date, thereby reducing handling time and improving order fulfillment speed.
